leadText:
Alex Davis (Japanese: ノボル Noboru) is a Pokémon Trainer and a character of the day who appeared in Power Play!.

Announcing himself as "Alex Davis from Cherrygrove City", he challenged Gary Oak to a using his . However, Gary was able to defeat Alex without much trouble. , , and , who just walked nearby, saw the battle, leading to another encounter between Ash and his rival.
